messages:
mira: Quick sync — we need to lock scope for the next 2-week iteration. Do we prioritize the 3 quick customer bugfixes or the feature polish that unlocks new self-serve onboarding? TL;DR: low risk fixes vs bigger potential impact.
jon: My vote is bugs-first. Fixes reduce support load and unblock enterprise trials. Most are small and safe to ship.
ana: Design note — the polish needs ~3 dev days + validation with two pilot customers. Could we do a smaller subset to demo value earlier?
samir: @jon +1 for bugs, but FYI bug3 is a regression tied to the KV cache change — that one could recur unless we address runtime behavior.
lee: SRE perspective: the caching regression needs either a config revert or a runtime patch. Revert affects perf; runtime patch is ~2–4 days of work and needs careful canarying.
mira: Options on table: A) Ship all 3 bugfixes + a tiny polish subset. B) Do full polish instead of bug3 (push runtime fix later). C) Ship bug1+2 now and schedule bug3 in a dedicated hotfix sprint. Thoughts?
jon: I prefer A. We can scope the polish subset to the onboarding happy path and gate with a feature flag.
ana: I sketched two layout variants — will drop in #design for a quick vote. Variant minimal keeps visual consistency and is quick to implement.
samir: Important context: two paying customers flagged bug3 in support and are asking for an ETA this week.
mira: :thinking_face: ok that customer ask bumps priority. We should treat bug3 as higher urgency if they expect it this week.
jon: If customers expect bug3 immediately, recommend emergency hotfix for bug3 + ship bug1+2 in the sprint. Defer polish to next cycle.
lee: Technical plan: create a hotfix branch for bug3, run expedited CI, then canary to dedicated pools (10% traffic). I can own the canary monitoring and rollback criteria.
mira: Decision (tentative): pursue emergency hotfix for bug3 + include bug1+2 in this sprint, postpone polish subset to next iteration. Who will document rollout?
jon: I'll open the PRs and add a rollout checklist. Plan: hotfix branch -> canary (10% dedicated) -> expand -> full. Tagging @lee for canary approval.
lee: I'll schedule the canary window and monitor latency/errors. If KV cache error resurfaces we roll back to pre-cache config.
samir: I'll message the two customers with an expectation update and offer a follow-up once the hotfix is live. Also will update the internal support KB.
mira: :thumbsup: thanks — I’ll update the roadmap notes and move polish into the "nextwave" milestone. Any objections?
ana: No objections. I’ll prepare a tighter scope doc for the polish so it’s ready for the next sprint planning.
cortex-bot: Reminder: Next deploy window at 2024-04-03 18:00 UTC. Please submit canary approvals by EOD.
mira: Noted. Closing thread once the PR links are posted.
_description: thread about prioritizing bugs vs polish after launch, includes decision to hotfix a regression and postpone polish
